subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich before_tool_call event with action classification and input provenance

question: What public policy-facts contract should OpenClaw expose to `before_tool_call`: action categories, composable capability flags, input/requester provenance, external-content provenance, or a versioned combination of those?
rationale: This is public Plugin SDK security-policy surface; automation cannot choose the taxonomy, redaction boundary, or ordinary-vs-trusted plugin visibility without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Define One Unified Policy-Facts Contract
options.body: Recommended: approve one additive contract that covers action/capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it with docs, API baseline updates, and cross-path tests.

options.title: Land Narrow Provenance Slices First
options.body: Accept narrower PRs such as external-content or requester-origin signals while keeping this issue open for the broader action/provenance design.

options.title: Defer Hook Enrichment
options.body: Keep the existing hook shape and require security plugins to use tool names or trusted policy internals until the broader Security Matrix/capability model is settled.

recommendation.title: Define One Unified Policy-Facts Contract
recommendation.body: Recommended: approve one additive contract that covers action/capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it with docs, API baseline updates, and cross-path tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The hook contract history and current security-policy adjacency make vincentkoc the best available owner for the public SDK/security decision.
